name: Vamp Assistant
subtitle: Native Mac control and Assistant sessions from iPhone and iPad
description: Official AltStore source for the Vamp Assistant iPhone and iPad companion.

apps.name: Vamp Assistant
apps.subtitle: Control your trusted Mac and continue Assistant sessions remotely.
apps.localizedDescription: Pair with Vamp Assistant on your Mac to continue sessions, approve requests, exchange files, stream and control the Mac, and securely unlock it through Tailscale.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds clearly visible Version and Build information on the pairing screen and in Settings, plus the secure Tailscale-only Mac unlock flow.
Previous sideloadable iPhone and iPad release.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant scans the one-time pairing QR code shown by your Mac.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant connects to Vamp Assistant running on your trusted Mac.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant can dictate text onto your Mac from the Control keyboard.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant turns on-device speech into keystrokes on your Mac.

news.title: Vamp Assistant 0.1.34
news.caption: Version details are now visible in-app, with secure remote Mac unlock included.
